findings.item: Where the executing role is recorded
findings.claim: Chain record sequence 130 (EV-69bf082d25d6a5e7) has actor_role "harness" and notes only round_id/proof_sequence, the same as record 129 for line 5. The chain does not record that the verb ran with --as-role engineer. That Engineer attribution exists only as payload.role inside line 6, which the author declares about themselves. This is not a defect in the correction. It is a limit of what DEVAI 1.5.6 records, and the same limit applies to line 5.
findings.fix: No change to this append. If the maestro wants the --as-role value itself provable from the chain, open an issue or ADR against DEVAI so it records the declared role in the event. Until then, the evidence of Engineer attribution is the payload plus the maestro's report that the command ran with --as-role engineer.

findings.claim: The worktree has leftover temporary files (.raw.R8sfKs and .formatted.hBeigX) next to the correction and the append. They are not part of the evidence and must not go into the commit. The input evidence-CTG-0003-engineer-correction.json is still untracked, and line 6 anchors no artifact that points to it (its payload is the file itself, byte-for-byte after JSON parse).
